summary: Prompt 'Validate my webserver playbook to check for any issues' to run ansible-lint in check-only mode, listing rule IDs, line numbers and descriptions (e.g. missing FQCN, YAML formatting); the assistant then asks permission, and allow applies the fixes while skip just lists suggested fixes.
questions: How do I validate a playbook with the AI assistant without changing it?
Does the assistant change my code without asking?
What happens if I choose skip when the assistant offers fixes?
Run ansible-lint in check-only mode from Copilot
